_readme: Placed cakes and puddings: block id -> the item a bite from the placed block counts as for Spice of Life (patcherMod food.PlacedFoodSol).
Farmer's Delight pies (PieBlock and its subclasses) need no entry: a bite counts as the pie's own slice item.
A cake with its own slice item counts as that slice; a cake without one counts as Farmer's Delight's cake slice, like the vanilla cake.
minecraft:cake is here only for its candle cakes (Spice of Life records bites of the plain cake itself). A candle cake counts as the cake it turns into.
The item must be edible (Spice of Life drops non-food items). Read at server start; a restart applies changes.
